title.narrative: Year 1 payment for the project 'I am girl' Alleviating barriers to girls

description.narrative: The ‘I AM GIRL - Alleviating barriers to adolescent girls and boys participating in and completing education in Eastern Uganda’ project aims to reduce the barriers faced by adolescent girls and boys participating in and completing their education, such as poor menstruation and health management, unsafe environments, and inadequate nutrition, together with the implementing partner Fields of Life East Africa. The objectives are to provide clean water; improved water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) facilities; personal hygiene and skills training; challenge negative norms on child rights and gender-based issues; develop school child protection policies; and promote school feeding. The key activities include capacity building of school management for effective service delivery, improving WASH facilities in target schools so that they are clean, functional and gender friendly, creating awareness on child protection and gender-based violence, and the creation of parent led school feeding committees.
